title: Epidemiological Case-Control Study Design for Alignment Failures

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: identifying risk factors for alignment failures via case-control methodology enables screening. The analogy to epidemiology is creative. However, the sample size needed for meaningful odds ratios may be prohibitive.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires collecting a sample of fine-tuning runs (cases and controls), which means running many fine-tuning experiments. Case-control statistical analysis requires epidemiological methodology knowledge. Both the data generation and analysis are challenging for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Needs many fine-tuning runs to generate case/control samples, then statistical analysis across multiple risk factors. The data generation step alone could consume 30 hours of compute.
